title: Framework Icon Interface
description: Replace direct lucide-react usage with vendored SVGs in @ui/assets, library-agnostic Icon primitive in @ui/react, framework-owned chrome icons, and js/net/py codegen.
summary: Added @ui/assets package with 121 vendored Lucide ISC SVGs, script.ts codegen (icons.ts, Icons.cs, icons.py), and README attribution. Added Icon/IconSource/IconName/createIconComponent to @ui/react; migrated framework platform/playground renderers to unified registerIcon + PANEL_KIND_ICON; presentation uses Icon for reset/maximize. Migrated @compose/assets to createIconComponent wrappers. Updated storybook stories and cad play off lucide. Vitest: platform icon tests use data-icon; ui/react vfs tests updated (135/136 pass; one pre-existing tree guide test still fails).
